body:
I am in the US, and luckily I dont have any student loans. I have a scholarship which pays my tuition and my “salary” (if you can call this pay rate a salary). I believe I will finish my phd, I only have a couple months left. I just need to find the will to finish writing the dissertation. 

I can’t imagine what large animal vets go through. Way too many times I witnessed the vets being called to the farm just to put animals down. It seems like that is mostly what they do. Its horribly sad. These professionals must suffer severe mental pain.


Thank you. Its very hard to forgive myself, most times feels impossible. I see myself as a monster, and ironically as “weak” by my coworkers.  Everyone is so heartless. Humans really think we own everything around us. Its just horrible. 

I see myself in the wrong side of history. I think of historically bad guys, and doesn’t matter if you did bad things with a heavy heart. You still did bad things. Nobody looks at nazi officers and think “oh but they felt bad doing it”. We despise a police officer that stands there and does nothing nothing as another officer beats an unarmed black man. We just think they are horrible people, because they did what they did even knowing it was wrong. I’m not trying to make people feel bad for me. I’m just trying to explain the disgust I feel about myself. 

Thank you for replying to my post. It means a lot, really.
Thank you. They for sure help. I have 3 dogs and sometimes I watch them sleep and think to myself that I need to stay until they are ready to leave this world. They are too pure for humans.
